d: We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Portals Listing Coordinator to join our dynamic real estate team. The Portals Listing Coordinator will be responsible for managing all aspects of property listings, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency throughout the process. This role requires excellent communication, multitasking, and problem-solving skills
q: Previous experience in real estate administration or a similar role preferred
Strong organizational and time management skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
Knowledge of real estate laws, contracts, and compliance requirements is a plus
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
r: Prepare and manage property listings in the CRM and dedicated portals
Maintain and update property details, descriptions, and photos
Ensure all listing documentation is completed accurately and in compliance with legal requirements
Coordinate photography, videography, and virtual tours for new listings
Track listing performance and provide reports to the team
Support real estate agents with listing-related administrative tasks
